title: Guidance and checklists on using AI in legal practice in Victoria
summary: The VLSB+C has published guidance and checklists on using AI safely. It states that lawyers remain responsible for AI-assisted work and must keep it consistent with their professional duties, including confidentiality.
what_changes: New checklist for law practice leaders and principals on introducing and managing AI in a practice.
New checklist for lawyers on using AI in line with their professional obligations.
Regulator flags unchecked AI output, including hallucinated cases in court documents, and seniors not checking juniors' AI work.
Regulator warns against uploading sensitive client information into public-facing AI tools.
who_it_applies_to: Victorian lawyers and law practices, with the regulator noting particular value for small practices and sole practitioners.

history.event: VLSB+C published new AI guidance and checklists for lawyers and law practice leaders.
